basis: G.30--G.33 replace the previously unproved equivariant interval/quotient resolution with a canonical bisimplicial model for every smooth locally free monoid. Its local fibres are K(A,1) for locally cyclic A; the stabilizer row is proved acyclic in positive horizontal degrees. The remaining degree-two obstruction is exactly ker(d2:H2(NT/(K semidirect G)) -> direct sum of cut stabilizers), and higher source homology equals higher quotient-tree homology. This is a strictly smaller universal main gate, not only a candidate calculation.
